data.question: I'm having issues starting my air purifier.
data.answer: • Ensure the plug is pushed completely into the outlet. Appliances should be plugged directly into a wall outlet.

data.question: No air is coming out of the top of the unit.
data.answer:
• Verify the plastic bag has been removed from the filter.
• Make sure there are no curtains, blinds, or furniture blocking the air intake.

data.question: My air quality has not improved after running for a long time.
data.answer:
• Verify the plastic bag has been removed from the filter.
• Make sure the filter is installed correctly.
• Lower your home’s humidity or place the unit in a less humid area.
• Make sure there are no curtains, blinds, or furniture blocking the air intake.
• The room may be too large. Check the product’s recommended coverage.

data.question: The unit has issues removing particles from the air.
data.answer:
• Verify the plastic bag has been removed from the filter.
• Depending on your environment, the filter may need to be replaced earlier. Try replacing filter for better results.

data.question: The air coming out of the air purifier has a particular smell.
data.answer: • In environments with strong smoke and other odors, the filter may need to be replaced earlier. Try replacing filter for better results.

data.question: There is a red indicator flashing for a long time.
data.answer: • The red-light indicator (flashing or solid) means you should replace the filter. Press the light key for 3 seconds to reset the filter lights.

data.question: I am not sure what Anion and UV-C technology is.
data.answer:
• Anion technology helps to settler finer particles in your air when the feature is enabled.
• UV-C technology helps to eliminate bacteria and viruses in your air when the feature is enabled.
• Note: These features are only available on select models.

data.question: How does the Breeva A2humidification work?
data.answer:
• Breeva A2 features a built-in evaporative humidifier that uses a tank of water that can be filled by opening the head of the unit.
• It uses a humidifying filter that absorbs the water, which is then dispersed into the air as the air passes over the humidifying filter.

data.question: How often do I need to add water to the Breeva A2 for the humidifier feature?
data.answer: • Depending on the use and conditions it is advisable to check every 24 hours.
